en: What was that voice just now...?

jp: 佳子の声だ\n場所は、どこだ？！
en: That's Yoshiko's voice! Where is it coming from?!

jp: こっちの方なのは\n確かです
娯楽室の方へ\n行ってみましょう！
en: Let's head toward the game room!

jp: 麟君、冷静だね\nこういうことに\n慣れてるみたい
en: Rin-kun is so calm. It's like he's used to this kind of thing.

jp: ふみゅ。りんりん\n思いの外、場慣れ\nしてるふう
en: Fumyu. Rin-Rin, unexpectedly seasoned in such scenes-fuu.

jp: あの麟って子\n全然、子供っぽくなくて\n冷静すぎ
en: That Rin kid isn't childish at all. He's way too calm.

jp: 言の葉使いは表の世界\nにも協力してるらしいし
en: Word Wielders apparently help out the everyday world too,

jp: 僕らが思ってるより\n色々と経験してる\nのかもね
en: so maybe he's been through more than we think.

jp: 【回廊で会った３人】\nの刻音を手に入れた！
en: Obtained the Echo [Three Met in the Corridor]!
